messages.text:
The essential oil set must arrive back at the shop before it can be refunded. A staff member cannot grant an exception to that rule, so both items cannot be refunded right now (refund-policy/v2/return; refund-policy/v2/exceptions).

As you requested, I won’t start a refund for either item. Please keep the request deadlines in mind: December 2 at 10:00 UTC for the diffuser and December 8 at 10:00 UTC for the oil set (refund-policy/v2/window).
